# GitHub Actions State Data

This directory contains state files for GitHub Actions workflows.

## Files

### `claude-code-changelog.md`

- **Purpose**: Stores the previous version of the Claude Code CHANGELOG
- **Updated by**: `.github/workflows/claude-changelog-monitor.yml`
- **Update frequency**: Twice weekly (Monday & Friday at 7:00 AM JST)
- **Format**: Markdown content from the official [Claude Code CHANGELOG](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

This file is automatically generated and committed by the GitHub Actions workflow. It serves as the state persistence mechanism for detecting new CHANGELOG updates.

## Important Notes

- Do not manually edit these files unless you know what you're doing
- These files are committed to git for transparency and audit trail
- The workflow uses `[skip ci]` in commit messages to prevent infinite loops
